Project.NAME: Agent Lab
Project.keywords: agent, lab, llm, orchestration, sandbox, prompt, tests, opencode, configuration, tools
Project.annotation: CLI-driven, OpenCode-centered experiment runner: vary system prompt / model / task prompt, run isolated in Docker ("vacuum"), capture and compare agent behavior. Agents are the primary callers; humans secondary.

M-CONFIG.NAME: Config
M-CONFIG.purpose: Parse and validate an experiment definition from CLI args and/or a config file, and expand a variation matrix.

fn-loadExperiment.PURPOSE: Parse and validate a single experiment definition

fn-expandMatrix.PURPOSE: Expand a variation matrix into concrete experiment definitions

M-LOGGER.NAME: Logger
M-LOGGER.purpose: Structured logging with stable marker fields and secret redaction.

fn-createLogger.PURPOSE: Create a child logger with redaction and marker bindings

M-TRACE.NAME: Trace
M-TRACE.purpose: Normalize raw OpenCode events into a stable RunTrace and diff traces, independent of the SDK surface.

fn-normalizeEvents.PURPOSE: Fold raw OpenCode events into a RunTrace

fn-diffTraces.PURPOSE: Produce a structured diff across RunTraces

type-RunTrace.PURPOSE: runId, experiment, status, timings, steps[], tokenUsage, finalOutput, error?

M-SANDBOX.NAME: Sandbox
M-SANDBOX.purpose: Provision and tear down an isolated Docker container per run with deny-by-default network plus LLM allowlist and guaranteed cleanup.

fn-createSandbox.PURPOSE: Provision an isolated container and return a handle

type-SandboxHandle.PURPOSE: Lifecycle handle for one sandbox (exec, dispose)

M-OPENCODE.NAME: OpenCodeAdapter
M-OPENCODE.purpose: Drive OpenCode (opencode serve + @opencode-ai/sdk) inside a sandbox and stream raw events to M-TRACE.

fn-runOpenCode.PURPOSE: Run one OpenCode session and return its normalized trace

M-STORE.NAME: TraceStore
M-STORE.purpose: Persist and retrieve experiment runs and their traces as flat JSON under runs/<runId>/.

fn-saveRun.PURPOSE: Persist a run record and trace

fn-getRun.PURPOSE: Load a run record by id

M-ENGINE.NAME: ExperimentEngine
M-ENGINE.purpose: Orchestrate experiments end to end with bounded parallelism, guaranteed cleanup, and a comparison facade.
M-ENGINE.depends: M-CONFIG, M-SANDBOX, M-OPENCODE, M-STORE, M-TRACE, M-LOGGER

fn-runExperiment.PURPOSE: Run one or many experiments with bounded parallelism

fn-compareRuns.PURPOSE: Load runs via M-STORE and diff them via M-TRACE

M-CLI.NAME: Cli
M-CLI.purpose: Expose the engine to agents and humans as run/list/show/compare with parseable stdout.
